description: This Python script named 'lua_generator.py' provides functionality to generate Lua scripts based on a configuration JSON file and a template Lua file. It includes functions to read configuration data, replace placeholders in the template with generated code segments, and a Tkinter-based GUI for user interaction to select configuration files and trigger code generation.

classes.name: App
classes.description: A GUI application class built with Tkinter that allows users to select configuration files and generate corresponding Lua scripts by invoking 'generate_lua_code'. It manages user interactions and UI components for file selection and operation execution.

methods.name: generate_lua_code(config_path='config.json', template_path='main.lua.template', output_path='main.lua')
methods.description: Reads the specified JSON configuration and a Lua template file, processes the configuration data to generate code segments, performs string replacements in the template, and writes the final Lua script to the output path.

methods.name: App.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the GUI, setting up the main window, style, and interface components including file selection entry, browse button, and generate button.

methods.name: App.browse_config
methods.description: Opens a file dialog for the user to select a JSON configuration file and updates the path variable.

methods.name: App.run_generation
methods.description: Initiates Lua code generation by calling 'generate_lua_code' with the selected config file path, and displays success or error messages accordingly.
